decisions.reason: It supports the firm's stated push into compliance and agency-focused features, and the dedicated page plus positive agency feedback suggest enough strategic fit to continue.
A web hosting management platform sits at the core of the firm's offer and its placement on the home page indicates it is strategically important rather than a candidate for withdrawal.
A configurable managed hosting plan is close to the established business and likely strengthens upselling and customer retention, so it is more likely to be refined than removed.
